data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Preiswecker is a price comparison portal in Germany, helping thousands of users find the best deals online every day.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team and help build our price comparison platform.

We are currently offering the following position:

Software Engineer - Price comparison portal

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain features for our price comparison platform
  • Develop and optimize data pipelines that process merchant price feeds
  • Work closely with Product and BI to ship reliable, scalable features
  • Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews
  • Monitor and improve performance of our systems

Qualifications

  • completed degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • solid experience with backend development and relational databases
  • familiarity with modern software engineering practices (testing, CI/CD, version control)
  • analytical mindset and a strong sense of ownership
  • good German and English

Benefits

  • flexible working hours and remote work options
  • flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths
  • modern office in a central location
  • training budget
  • fair salary and growth opportunities

We look forward to your application!

Preiswecker

data.title: Account Manager - DACH
data.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

This is a builder's role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue.

You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll dig into how customers deploy ElevenLabs across web, mobile, and their systems, spot the problems before they do, inspire new use-cases and own the solution end to end. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business.

 

What this looks like day to day

You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.

You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross-sell, and net expansion. You'll spot expansion opportunities early, own renewals and upsells end to end, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, and CS leadership to turn technical wins into revenue.

 

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in the DACH region

  • Proven experience of owning and managing a defined Book of Business

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Proven experience working across the DACH market. Knowledge of the landscape and cultural nuances

  • Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents

  • Strong builder mindset - you thrive in ambiguity and being a pioneer, finding ways to innovate across a full region or market to drive revenue outcomes

  • Familiarity and experience with API Integrations, and comfort and knowledge of navigating SDKs

  • Proven experience working cross functionally with Sales, Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams

  • Proven experience driving revenue outcomes, including owning a revenue quota and identifying, qualifying, and closing cross-sell opportunities along with renewals

  • Excellent problem-solving, technical, and analytical skills to address customer needs and concerns

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with customers at all levels of an organization

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote or distributed team environment

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Germany, Austria, or Switzerland.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

data.title: Programme Manager (d/f/m) - Office of the CFO
data.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:

As our Programme Manager (d/f/m) in the Office of the CFO within the G&A organization, you'll sit at the heart of one of the most strategically important functions at Taxfix. Reporting directly to the CFO and working closely with G&A leadership, you'll be the connective tissue that keeps critical initiatives moving — from shaping how we communicate our story, to driving the operational rhythms that make a high-performing G&A team tick.

You'll also play a key role in how we build and scale AI-native ways of working within G&A, identifying where intelligent tooling can sharpen decision-making, accelerate execution, and give the CFO's office a genuine edge. You don't just recommend — you build. You know when to think and when to act, and you're comfortable moving from insight to working solution. This is a role for someone who thrives on complexity, earns trust quickly, and knows how to turn ambiguity into momentum. If you're energized by working at the intersection of strategy, execution, and emerging technology, and you're ready to make a real impact on a company that's changing how millions of people relate to their finances: we'd love to meet you!


Your responsibilities:

  • Lead and execute key strategic and urgent projects for the CFO and G&A organization, from inception through to completion, ensuring alignment with company-wide priorities.

  • Serve as a trusted sounding board for the CFO on new ideas and initiatives, bringing structured thinking and candid perspective to early-stage conversations.

  • Initiate and guide the OKR process for G&A, coordinating inputs across the leadership team and ensuring goals are ambitious, measurable, and well-communicated.

  • Own the development and coordination of preparation and strategy for G&A leadership meetings — including offsite cadence, content, action items, evolution of the team and follow-up execution.

  • Own and steward G&A’s internal and external communications strategy — acting as the thoughtful custodian of the Finance division's voice and narrative, working with PR & Comms and the EA to the CFO to ensure messaging lands consistently and on time.

  • Serve as the directly responsible individual for cross-functional G&A processes and handbook alignment.

  • Partner closely with the EA to the CFO — you set the strategic direction and own the content; the EA ensures operational execution and coordination around it.

  • Identify and lead the implementation of AI-powered tools and workflows within the G&A function — from decision-support tooling to automated reporting — that increase the quality and speed of strategic work.

  • Don't just recommend — build. You're comfortable moving from insight to prototype, spinning up lightweight solutions (workflows, tools, templates) that create immediate value while longer-term solutions are designed.

  • Partner with G&A leadership to embed AI-native practices into how the team operates: how we prepare for meetings, manage OKRs, synthesize information, and communicate externally.

  • Stay current on developments in AI relevant to G&A — bringing informed, practical recommendations rather than hype — and serve as a thought partner to the CFO on where intelligent tooling creates genuine leverage.

Your profile:

  • You have a deep understanding of G&A as a function paired with strong general business acumen that allows you to connect the dots across complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

  • You bring deep project management experience and a proven track record of leading complex initiatives from inception to completion — you know how to create structure where there is none and keep things moving even when the path isn't clear.

  • You have a builder's mindset — you don't just identify what needs to change, you roll up your sleeves and make it happen. Whether that's designing a new process, standing up an AI workflow, or structuring a framework from scratch, you know when to think and when to build.

  • You're a natural problem solver with a bias for action: you find scalable solutions, work comfortably with abstract ideas across multiple areas, and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty.

  • You've handled sensitive and confidential financial material in a public company setting, and you bring the discretion and judgment that comes with it.

  • You communicate with clarity and confidence — whether in writing or in person — and you're equally comfortable presenting to the C-Suite and Board as you are collaborating with peers across the organization.

  • You're excited about AI and have hands-on experience applying AI tools or building AI-powered workflows in a professional context — you understand where the technology genuinely helps and where it falls short.

  • You're a calm, organized, and low-ego operator who works well with a wide range of people, inspires collaborative solutions, and knows when to lead and when to listen.

  • You're genuinely excited by new challenges and have a track record of growing your scope over time by consistently delivering and earning trust

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

data.title: Partner Engagement Manager, U.S. Army Europe and Africa
data.description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Required: Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI

In person in Grafenwöhr, Germany

 

Why This Role Exists

As a Partner Engagement Manager at Onebrief, you're the customer's trusted technical partner. You serve as the subject-matter expert, maintaining power-user-level fluency in the platform. You stay current on product updates, translating new releases into practical impact for the specific workflows your customer relies on. You act as the primary line of communication between the customer and Onebrief — as the product evolves, you deliver ongoing, role-specific training to ensure users adopt new capabilities rather than getting stuck on outdated workflows. You bridge the technical gap between engineering and the customer, explaining product behavior in terms their staff can actually act on.

 

What You’ll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Clearly communicate user needs to the product team. Maintain a high product proficiency, and excite the customer about each product improvement.

  • Understand, request, and effectively leverage Company resources to meet the goals of the Company.

  • Lead or support exercises.

  • Use your observations of our users to recommend product improvements.

  • Identify gaps between existing directorate workflows and effective Onebrief usage, then drive adoption through hands-on configuration, user coaching, and workflow optimization.

  • When responding to incidents (product is unavailable, broken, or not delighting the customer), coordinate with the customer and our product engineering team.

  • Align your team’s efforts to deliver the best customer experience, while coordinating with fellow Partner Engagement Managers to ensure planning and workflows remain synchronized across commands.

  • Enable expansion and upsell opportunities to Allies and Partners by instilling the Onebrief value proposition.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in leading operational planning within a military context, preferably at multi-star headquarters.

  • Exposure to large staff planning, through classical training in Professional Military Education or through service experience

  • Familiarity and experience with major military planning exercises and the protocols for software deployment on classified networks.

  • Proven ability to expand business presence within a customer location with emphasis on software or technology solutions.

  • Experience in customer support, both face-to-face and remote, and capability to respond to incidents coordinating with customers and product engineering teams.

  • Strong technical skills to master our application, troubleshoot issues and liaise with customers on technical matters.

  • Proven ability to navigate large government organizations, solve bureaucratic challenges, and deliver successful outcomes.

  • You hold a current Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI and have the ability to access DOD facilities and installations.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • You’re technically adept. You don’t need to code, but you do need to be savvy. Can you become a power user of our product and talk engineering with the customer?

  • Customers trust you. You demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, develop rapport, align diverse perspectives, and communicate with clarity and influence.

  • You’re intense about our mission. It’s a core part of who you are

  • You’re proactive and adaptable. You see a problem and get to work. You’re comfortable working autonomously or in a cross-functional team, especially in a fast-paced or ambiguous setting

  • You communicate clearly, concisely, and candidly. Our Company relies on you to assess the situation within your account and effectively communicate your assessment and recommendations to inform strategic decisions.

 

Indicators of Success

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Partner Engagement Manager will:

  • Opinion and expertise are valued by the customer and company alike (rapport/trust)

  • Learns quick, identifies opportunities and drives progress within the account (Forward-leaning/ bias for action)

  • Open-minded and able to pivot when priorities shift (Adaptability/ Humility)


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

Compensation: $150K – $180K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

  • • $150K – $180K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Als Cloud Monitoring Manager (m/w/d) Wärmepumpe bist du die erste technische Instanz, wenn Anlagen nicht so funktionieren wie sie sollen. Die Störungsanalyse und Fehlerbehebung erfolgen dabei vollständig remote, über unsere eigenen sowie herstellereigene Cloud- und Monitoring-Plattformen, auf denen Anlagendaten in Echtzeit einlaufen (z. B. die Panasonic Aquarea Smart Cloud).

  • Reaktiver Support: Bearbeitung eingehender App-Monitoring-Tickets, Kundenanfragen und Störungsmeldungen – schnell, kompetent und lösungsorientiert.

  • Technischer Support & Anlagensteuerung: Analyse von Kundenproblemen aus der Ferne, Vornahme von Anlageneinstellungen sowie Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Nachbereitung von Service-Einsätzen.

  • Problemlösung & Fehleranalyse: Entwicklung skalierbarer Lösungsansätze für wiederkehrende Störungsbilder – z. B. bei Warmwasser, Lautstärkebeschwerden oder mangelhafter Heizleistung.

  • Wissensmanagement: Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Bedienungsanleitungen, FAQs sowie internen Wissensdatenbanken – damit technisches Know-how im Team zugänglich bleibt.

  • Dokumentation & Recherche: Recherche von Fachfragen, Normen und Wärmepumpenregelungen mit strukturierter Dokumentation für den internen Gebrauch.

  • Kapazitätsmanagement: Aktive Unterstützung beim Abfedern saisonaler Lastspitzen – gleichbleibend hohe Lösungsqualität auch in Hochphasen.

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Maschinenbau, Energietechnik, Gebäudetechnik, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Fach.

  • Technisches Verständnis für Heizungsanlagen und Wärmepumpen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englisch von Vorteil.

  • Nice to have: Erfahrung im Monitoring von Photovoltaik-, Wärmepumpe- oder Elektroauto-Daten.

Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig:

  • Methodical Problem Solver: Du gehst Störungen systematisch auf den Grund, findest die Ursache – nicht nur das Symptom – und entwickelst Lösungen, die das Problem nachhaltig beheben. Deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe hilft dir, neue Fehlerbilder zügig einzuordnen.

  • Proactive Documenter: Du erkennst, wann Wissen festgehalten werden muss, und hältst Prozesse, Lösungen und Standards kontinuierlich aktuell – klar formuliert, strukturiert und für andere direkt nutzbar.

  • Resilient Operator: Du behältst auch in saisonalen Hochphasen mit hohem Ticketvolumen den Überblick, priorisierst sauber und lieferst konstant hohe Qualität.

  • Technical Curiosity: Du willst verstehen, warum etwas nicht funktioniert, nicht nur wie man es behebt. Du gehst tiefer als nötig, liest dich ein und baust so ein Fachwissen auf, das dem gesamten Team zugutekommt.

Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth.

Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network.

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business.

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem.
  • You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities.
  • You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems.
  • You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability.
  • You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.
  • You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.
  • You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes.

  • Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus).
  • Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics.
  • Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation.

data.title: Senior Vendor Manager / Lieferantenmanager Telekommunikation (m/w/d)
data.description:
Was diesen Job so besonders macht?

Als Senior Vendor Manager / Lieferantenmanager Telekommunikation (m/w/d) übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle im Glasfaserausbau von OXG. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Bau- und Ausbaupartner zuverlässig, qualitativ hochwertig und wirtschaftlich arbeiten – und bringst gleichzeitig moderne Tools und KI‑Ansätze in unser Lieferantenmanagement ein.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Baupartnern zusammen, um die Qualität ihrer Leistungen und Produkte innerhalb der vereinbarten Zeit- und Budgetziele sicherzustellen. 
  • Gemeinsam mit unseren Ausbaupartnern reviewst du regelmäßig und engmaschig Qualität und Lieferleistung: Du überwachst die Performance verschiedener Partner und Lieferanten und treibst die  Entwicklung und Implementierung von Maßnahmen voran, um Prozesse und Produktivität kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Du gehst Qualitätsabweichungen bei Partnern systematisch nach und identifizierst Ursachen und stellst sicher, dass Maßnahmenpläne entwickelt und fristgerecht umgesetzt werden.
  • Du erkennst Optimierungspotenziale entlang der gesamten Prozesskette – von Planung, über Bau (NE3) bis Umsetzung vor Ort (NE4) und Dokumentation – und setzt Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit unseren internen und externen Stakeholdern um.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und dem Etablieren KI‑gestützter Monitoring‑ und Reportingansätze für das Vendor Management (z.B. für Partner-Performance, Risikofrüherkennung, Forecasting, Qualitätsmanagement) und entwickelst diese mit uns weiter.
  • Du übernimmst eine wichtige Rolle in der Risikosteuerung: Dazu gehört insbesondere der professionelle Umgang mit insolvenzgefährdeten Partnerunternehmen und deren Nachunternehmern, inklusive Bewertung, Neuaufstellung und Übergangsszenarien.
  • Du bist Teil eines dynamischen Teams, in dem ihr systematisch Erfahrungen teilt und Best-Practices identifiziert und organisationsweit implementiert 


Wann passt Du zu uns?

  • Du hast mindesten 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Lieferantenbetreuung bzw. im Vendor Management, idealerweise im Telekommunikations- oder Glasfaser-Umfeld. 
  • Du verfügst über ein erprobtes und belastbares Lieferantennetzwerk in NE3 und NE4 (Planungs- und Bauunternehmen, Nachunternehmer) und weißt, wie du dieses Netzwerk strategisch weiterentwickelst.
  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit insolvenzgefährdeten Bauunternehmen und deren Nachunternehmern – von der Risikoanalyse über Vertrags- und Leistungsanpassungen bis hin zu Exit- und Ersatzszenarien.
  • Du bringst Verhandlungsgeschick und eine exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeit mit – sowohl gegenüber internen Stakeholdern (z.B. Deployment, Projektmanagement, Einkauf, Legal) als auch externen Partnern.

  • Du hast Erfahrungen und sehr gute Kenntnisse im Bereich FttH-Ausbau (passive und aktive Netzkomponenten).
  • Du bist ein verantwortungsbewusster Teamplayer mit Start-up-Mindset: eigeninitiativ, serviceorientiert, selbstständig und neugierig für Neues in einem stark wachsenden Markt.
  • Dich zeichnen herausragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch (C2) und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch (B1) aus.
  • Du bringst einen Führerschein der Klasse B mit

data.title: Working Student System Administration (all genders)
data.description:
YOUR IMPACT - YOUR ROLE

Show us how you rock IT!

You juggle bits and bytes while others are still looking for their coffee cups? Then join our dynamic and modern company, where innovation and agility are lived. With us, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills further and be part of an international team.

For this, we are looking for you as our Working Student System Administration (all genders).

Your mission in detail:

  • As our Working Student System Administration, you are the contact person for all hardware and software problems and support the Helpling team with questions regarding the IT infrastructure in our Berlin office.

  • You support the provisioning and maintenance of our Windows- and OSX-based environment and help provide your colleagues with high-speed, bugless equipment.

  • You help manage our local networks and support troubleshooting, analysis, and documentation.

  • You bring your own ideas to improve existing workflows through customized automation.

  • You help ward off cyber attacks, create backups, and contribute to our overall IT security.


WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

A vocational training or degree is not the most important thing to us. We value your experience and are therefore looking for practically-versed, plug-and-play heroes with versatile IT knowledge who are currently enrolled at a university.

  • You are familiar with help desk user support, Google Workspace, setting up VLAN and VPN, as well as Windows and OSX systems, and ideally, you even bring first knowledge of a programming language.

  • You are reliable, motivated, and effortlessly juggle multiple inquiries at the same time.

  • You live in Berlin/Brandenburg and value our beautiful office in Berlin Mitte as your second 127.0.0.1

  • You are enrolled as a student throughout your time with us and can work up to 20 hours per week.

  • German language skills are a plus, very good English is a must.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US

Flexibility: Flexible working & an office in Berlin Mitte for networking and socializing

Personal development: you work in a small team that gives you the opportunity to bring in your individual strengths and ideas and actively shape the future of Helpling.

Growth: define your individual growth path with the help of our feedback cycle, leadership workshops, book club, or lunch & learns

Vacation: up to 30 vacation days per year, depending on length of service. In addition, we give away up to 10 additional vacation days per year in cool campaigns, e.g., advent calendar or health challenges

Family & Career: we pay you 5 additional child sick days per year when your child needs you

Company Pension Scheme: with up to 20% employer contribution

Focus on the essentials, we'll take care of the rest: we offer you a discount for your own domestic help via Helpling.de


APPLY NOW

If this role sounds like you, then send us your application documents, including your availability and proof of current enrollment.

We would like to encourage you to apply even if you do not yet meet 100% of our expectations listed above. For us, your personality and motivation are just as important as your professional qualifications.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin, migration history, marital status, age, or disability.

data.title: Data Platform Engineer (f/m/d)
data.description:
Your mission

We have challenging tasks for you:

As a Data Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for building and evolving modern cloud platforms for Data & AI. Together with our team and our clients, you will develop platforms that can be operated in a scalable, secure, and sustainable manner.

In doing so, you will combine cloud infrastructure, platform architecture, and modern Data & AI technologies into solutions that create a stable foundation for analytics, data engineering, and AI use cases.

In detail, you will:

  • Design, build, and continuously evolve cloud-based Data & AI platforms

  • Develop platform strategies and target architectures together with our clients and implement them technically

  • Design scalable and robust platform architectures that serve as a foundation for data-driven solutions

  • Provision modern cloud infrastructures on Azure or AWS automatically using Infrastructure as Code

  • Work specifically with Terraform or OpenTofu as well as modern CI/CD processes

  • Design and evolve Databricks platforms regarding workspaces, compute, networking, identity, security, and governance

  • Make architecture decisions and establish best practices for performance, security, governance, scalability, and cost optimization

  • Develop reusable platform blueprints, standards, and automations

  • Evaluate new technologies and platform components and integrate them meaningfully into existing architectures

  • Support data, analytics, and AI teams by providing stable and high-performance platforms

  • Contribute to technical concepts, architecture workshops, and the further development of our standards together with our team


Your profile

What we are looking for

You work in a structured manner, think in terms of platforms and architectures, and implement technical solutions cleanly and sustainably.

Ideally, you bring to the table:

  • Sound experience in building modern cloud infrastructures and platform architectures

  • Excellent knowledge of at least one cloud platform, ideally Microsoft Azure or AWS

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, e.g., Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep, or comparable technologies

  • A strong understanding of scalable, secure, and maintainable system and platform architectures

  • Experience with technologies in the Data & AI domain, particularly Databricks

  • Knowledge in areas such as cloud networking, identity & access management, security, and governance

  • Basic software development skills, e.g., with Python, as well as experience handling APIs and automation

  • Experience with Git and CI/CD

  • A solid understanding of the requirements that data, analytics, ML, and AI workloads place on a modern platform

  • A completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification

  • The ability to quickly learn new technologies and apply them purposefully

  • A structured, self-reliant, and solution-oriented way of working

data.description:
Westbridge-Gruppe | Was uns antreibt

Gebäude müssen heute mehr leisten als je zuvor: effizienter werden, Ressourcen schonen und gleichzeitig wirtschaftlich betrieben werden. Dafür braucht es Transparenz, messbare Daten und intelligente Lösungen. 

Als einer der führenden Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberater für die Immobilienwirtschaft in Europa treiben wir diesen Wandel aktiv mit. Wir unterstützen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden dabei, Gebäude und Portfolios fit für die Zukunft zu machen – von der ersten strategischen Idee über die technische Planung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. 

Um diesen Weg weiterzugehen und gemeinsam mit unseren Kundinnen und Kunden die Energieversorgung von morgen zu gestalten, suchen wir dich als Working Student im Projektmanagement (m/w/d) für unser Team Energy International in Frankfurt am Main.


Deine Aufgaben

In deiner Rolle übernimmst du Verantwortung und arbeitest gemeinsam mit deinem Team an Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Fragestellungen. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

  • Du unterstützt das Projektmanagement International bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer Konzepte zur Kostenoptimierung sowie Effizienzsteigerung im Energieverbrauch.
  • Im Rahmen deiner Tätigkeit wirkst Du bei der Analyse, Aufbereitung und Auswertung projektrelevanter Daten mit und leistest damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Entscheidungsfindung.
  • Du unterstützt das Team im operativen Projektmanagement-Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst dabei organisatorische und koordinative Aufgaben.
  • Zudem begleitest du Ausschreibungsprozesse sowie Bietergespräche und unterstützt bei der Kommunikation mit externen Partnern, insbesondere internationale Energieversorgern.
  • Die Vorbereitung und Strukturierung von Vertragsunterlagen für Verhandlungen gehört ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabenbereich.
  • Darüber hinaus erstellst du Präsentationen zur Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und wirkst bei der Aufbereitung von Ergebnissen für interne und externe Stakeholder mit.


Das bringst du mit

Fachliche Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, sind für uns genauso wichtig wie deine Freude an Zusammenarbeit und daran, gemeinsam gute Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium an einer Fach- oder Hochschule – vorzugsweise in den Bereichen Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Energiewirtschaft oder BWL.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Projektmanagement oder in der Energie- bzw. Immobilienwirtschaft gesammelt.
  • Du zeichnest dich durch lösungsorientiertes, analytisches und strukturiertes Denken und Handeln aus.
  • Teamfähigkeit und Einsatzbereitschaft gehören ebenso zu deinen Stärken wie ein professionelles und sicheres Auftreten.
  • Du verfügst über gute Grundkenntnisse in MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere in Excel.


So arbeiten wir

Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unterschiedlichen Fachrichtungen zusammen und erhältst Einblicke in spannende Projekte und Themen rund um die Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberatung. Dabei kannst du dein Wissen aus dem Studium einbringen, praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln. 

Damit dies gelingt, bieten wir dir die entsprechenden Rahmenbedingungen: Wir bieten dir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem du dich gut einfinden und konzentriert arbeiten kannst – mit moderner Ausstattung, guter Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr sowie Getränken, Snacks und frischem Obst. 

Bei Werkstudententätigkeiten richten wir uns nach deinem Studium: Während des Semesters kannst du uns bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen, in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit nach Absprache auch in Vollzeit. Praktika absolvierst du bei uns in Vollzeit.


Dein nächster Schritt

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und mit dir darüber zu sprechen, wie dein nächster beruflicher Schritt aussehen soll – und ob wir der richtige Partner dafür sind.

Backend-Systeme und digitale Produkte. Du arbeitest mit aktuellen Technologien, nutzt 
AI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag und begleitest Projekte von der Konzeption bis zur 
Umsetzung. Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwickelst Du bestehende Lösungen weiter,

aktiv mit.

    zusammen.

data.title: Lead Frontend Engineer (m/f/d) - Web Platform & Architecture
data.description:
Your mission

As a Lead Frontend Engineer (m/f/d), you will be a key driver in shaping and evolving our web platform in a dynamic, technology-driven environment. You are comfortable working across architecture, hands-on development, and the continuous improvement of our applications, with a strong focus on quality, scalability, performance, and user experience.
At the intersection of Frontend Engineering, Backend, Product, and Platform, you will take technical ownership of key areas of our web platform. You will build high-performance, scalable, and user-centric solutions, actively shape our frontend architecture, and ensure sustainable technical decisions.
In this role, you will act as a technical leader and trusted sparring partner within the team. You challenge existing solutions, contribute ideas proactively, and help drive architecture, technology, and quality decisions. At the same time, you remain hands-on and work closely with the team to implement key initiatives. Your tasks:

Frontend Development & Architecture

  • Develop and maintain the frontend of our web platform using React and TypeScript
  • Contribute to architecture and design decisions for a modular and future-proof platform
  • Build reusable components, frontend modules, and backend-for-frontend solutions
  • Evolve our application architecture with a focus on maintainability, scalability, and performance
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs using Node.js and NestJS
  • Work in an agile team with close collaboration across Product, Backend, and Platform teams
Product, Quality & Automation
  • Deliver complex use cases with a strong focus on user experience and consistency
  • Translate business and design requirements into sustainable technical solutions
  • Design and implement modern testing and quality assurance strategies
  • Conduct code reviews and continuously improve code quality and maintainability
  • Drive automation, developer experience, and engineering standards
  • Continuously optimize frontend performance and overall user experience
AI-Assisted Engineering & Innovation
  • Leverage modern AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar solutions as part of the daily development workflow
  • Ensure the quality, security, and maintainability of AI-assisted software development
  • Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and engineering approaches
  • Contribute to our technical roadmap and AI-assisted engineering best practices
Technical Leadership & Collaboration
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to frontend engineers and adjacent teams
  • Help define architecture principles, quality standards, and engineering best practices
  • Support the team with complex technical challenges
  • Facilitate technical decision-making and collaborate closely with Product Management, Backend Engineering, and Platform teams


Your profile

Your Way of Working

  • You are solution-oriented and able to communicate complex technical topics in a structured way
  • You think beyond individual features and design solutions with scalability, maintainability, and user value in mind
  • You challenge architectures and processes constructively and actively seek better solutions
  • You communicate your ideas proactively and can explain technical decisions clearly
  • You take ownership and drive topics independently from concept to delivery
  • You combine technical leadership with a strong hands-on mentality
  • You enjoy collaborating and supporting other engineers through mentoring and knowledge sharing
  • Quality, performance, maintainability, and user experience are core principles for you
Your Qualifications
  • Degree in Computer Science or a comparable qualification
  • Several years of professional experience in modern web application development
  • Experience in a technical leadership or senior engineering role
  • Strong expertise in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and NestJS
  • Proven experience designing modern frontend architectures and RESTful APIs
  • Excellent understanding of modular application and system architectures
  • Experience with testing strategies, code reviews, and modern quality assurance practices
  • Experience with HTML, CSS, Sass, relational databases, and SQL
  • Experience with monorepos and modern dependency management is a plus
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered developer tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot
  • Experience mentoring and supporting the professional growth of engineers is a plus
Our Tech Stack
  • React & TypeScript
  • Node.js & NestJS
  • Zustand & Redux
  • Mantine & Material UI
  • SQL & Relational Databases
  • NX Monorepo & Renovate
  • RESTful APIs
  • Cursor & Claude Code
Languages

Our offer

data.title: Director Institutional Capital and Partnerships (m/w/d) – Frankfurt / Berlin / Hamburg
data.description:
Tätigkeitsbereich

Du verantwortest die Akquise institutioneller Kunden und Mandate mit Schwerpunkt Brown-to-Green im Bereich Residential. Dies beinhaltet Partnerschaften und Asset-Management-Mandate für die Transformation bestehender Portfolios sowie die Einwerbung institutionellen Eigenkapitals für unsere Immobilienstrategien – von Club Deals und Separate Accounts über Joint Ventures bis hin zu Fondsvehikeln. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für Investoren, führst Gespräche eigenständig bis zum Abschluss und baust die Partner- und Kapitalseite unserer Plattform systematisch aus.

Dabei geht die Rolle über den klassischen Vertrieb hinaus. Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Transaktion, Asset Management und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und bringst die Erwartungen der Investoren mit den operativen Gegebenheiten in Einklang.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Versorgungswerken, Pensionskassen, Versicherungen, Sparkassen, Stiftungen, Family Offices und Dachfonds
  • Eigenständige Ansprache, Qualifizierung und Betreuung von Investoren über den gesamten Prozess – vom Erstkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss
  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Investorenunterlagen, darunter Teaser, Pitch Decks, Track-Record-Darstellungen und Investment Memoranda
  • Steuerung von Due-Diligence-Prozessen auf Investorenseite, einschließlich der Koordination von RfPs, DDQs und Datenraumanfragen
  • Verhandlung kommerzieller Eckpunkte (Fee-Strukturen, Co-Investments, Governance und Reporting-Anforderungen) in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung
  • Kontinuierliche Marktbeobachtung mit Blick auf das Allokationsverhalten, Wettbewerbsvehikel und regulatorische Entwicklungen (Solvency II, AnlV, KAGB)
  • Pflege der Investoren-Pipeline im CRM sowie Sicherstellung eines belastbaren Reportings an die Geschäftsführung
  • Repräsentation des Unternehmens auf Branchenveranstaltungen wie der Expo Real, der MIPIM und relevanten Fachkonferenzen


Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5–8 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich Capital Raising, Investor Relations oder im institutionellen Vertrieb mit Immobilienbezug
  • Belastbares, aktives Netzwerk zu deutschen institutionellen Investoren sowie nachweisbare eigene Abschlüsse
  • Tiefgehendes Verständnis von Immobilienkennzahlen und -strukturen (u. a. IRR, Equity Multiple, Cash-on-Cash, Wasserfall, Leverage, Asset Deal vs. Share Deal)
  • Fundierte Kenntnis der regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen deutscher institutioneller Anleger
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands
Wünschenswert:
  • Erfahrung mit Value-Add- oder opportunistischen Strategien über Core hinaus
  • Vorerfahrung auf Investorenseite (z. B. in der Kapitalanlage oder in Immobilienreferaten)
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen LPs oder mit Luxemburger Strukturen
  • Bestehende Beziehungen zu Platzierungsberatern und Consultants


Unsere Benefits, wir schaffen

data.title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
data.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.
  • Talk to customers regularly and turn what you learn into design decisions
  • Help build and maintain a pragmatic design system that fits how we ship


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • B2B product design experience — you've designed complex software for professional users, not only consumer apps
  • A portfolio showing data-heavy, workflow-driven product work, and the reasoning behind it
  • Comfort working as a solo designer: you set your own process, make calls without waiting for sign-off, and know when "good enough to learn from" beats "perfect"
  • An early-stage mindset — priorities shift as we learn, and you treat ambiguity as something to work through, not around
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills; fluent in Figma
  • Willingness to talk to users directly and bring evidence into design discussions
  • Clear communication in English; German at a professional working level, since most of our customers operate in German and you'll need to understand their feedback directly
Nice to have:
  • Experience with industrial, manufacturing, energy, IoT, or other operational software
  • Familiarity with time-series data, dashboards, or monitoring and alerting products
  • Some front-end understanding — enough to work closely with engineers on feasibility and detail


How You’ll Grow

As the sole designer on a core product team, you'll set the design practice for Energy Insights largely on your own terms — there's no senior designer above you dictating process. You'll work closely enough with customers and engineers to see the direct consequences of your decisions, and as the product and team grow, you'll have the option to shape whether and how a design function scales beyond you.


What You Get

  • Real ownership: your designs define how industrial customers experience the product
  • Direct impact on a product that helps companies cut energy waste and costs
  • A small, senior-leaning team with short decision paths and close access to customers
  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Hybrid setup based in our Munich office, with regular in-person days alongside the team


The Application

Send us your CV and portfolio — we don't do long forms or generic cover letters. Surprise us.

data.title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
data.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

data.title: Head of Engineering (m/f/d)
data.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You lead engineering at ecoplanet: 11 engineers in two squads, including two squad leads.

This is the most senior engineering role in the company. There is no CTO above you. You own the technical direction, not just the delivery of someone else's plan, and you are the engineering voice on the leadership team.

It is also a hands-on job. With a team this size you stay close to the code and the architecture. If you have been away from technical work for a few years, this might not be the right role for you.

What you will own:

  • The team. 11 engineers, which includes two engineering managers. Hiring, performance, growth, and keeping good people
  • The systems. Our Cockpit SaaS platform, the metering and IoT integration layer, the data platform (time-series ingestion, quality, pipelines), the forecasting and optimization services, and the automation that acts on customer assets
  • The technical direction. Architecture, build-vs-buy, and the big platform calls
  • Delivery. Quarterly roadmap execution, owned together with Product
  • Operations. Reliability, on-call, incidents, security posture, and cloud spend


What You’ll Achieve

  • Get the best out of the team you have and grow only where it clearly adds. At 11 people, losing one strong engineer costs more than one extra hire gains. But you should be capable of growing the team substantially if business demands it
  • Turn the roadmap into commitments the company can count on. Surface dependencies early, clear blockers, and make the trade-off calls with Product and the founders.
  • We expect engineering to care about business and product and we expect you to be an example here
  • Set the architecture so it holds as data volume, customer count and the team grow.
  • Run incidents properly: fast response, honest postmortems, fixes that stop the same thing happening again
  • Keep enough processes to be reliable and no more. A 11-person team should not feel like a 100-person one
  • Work closely with Product, Data Science, our energy market experts and other disciplines, so we build against the real physical and regulatory constraints


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have

  • 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams before in a product company, including senior engineers or squad leads
  • You have done it in a lean team, hands-on, without a layer of managers to delegate to. Some excellent large-company leaders struggle here. There is no layer to hide behind
  • You have personally owned delivery predictability and reliability for a production system real customers depend on, and you can tell us what it looked like before and after
  • Strong technical judgment in at least two of: cloud and distributed backend / multi-tenant SaaS; high-volume or time-series data pipelines; IoT, device integration and real-time telemetry; ML or optimization in production. Deep enough to earn engineers' trust, make architecture calls and set the technical direction yourself
  • You have run hiring and performance for real: you have grown people, and you have also managed people out when that was the right call
  • You treat incident management, security and compliance as yours to own, not to delegate
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a strong plus — most of our customers are German Mittelstand
Nice to have
  • Energy, industrial, SaaS or a physical-world domain.
  • Having been the most senior technical person somewhere before (CTO, VP Engineering, or the person everyone asked).
Not required
  • Being the strongest coder on the team. You do need to read the code, make architecture calls, and occasionally build something.
  • A “Head of” title already. We look at what you have done, not what it was called.


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

data.title: Medical Director (m/w/x)
data.description:
Role

Als Medical Director verantwortest du den medizinischen Themenkatalog einer der größten CME-Lernplattformen Deutschlands. Was wir zeigen, erreicht unzählige Ärzt:innen – deine inhaltlichen Entscheidungen haben unmittelbaren Einfluss darauf, welches medizinische Wissen in Deutschland ankommt.

Du führst unser siebenköpfiges Medical Team, hältst den Kontakt zu Chefärzt:innen und Meinungsbildner:innen, entwickelst neue Fortbildungsformate mit und baust die Prozesse, mit denen wir vom Startup zum Scale-up werden. Die Rolle ist bewusst breit: strategisch in der Katalog- und Formatentwicklung, operativ im Tagesgeschäft, und immer mit der ärztlichen Perspektive als Maßstab.


Your tasks

  • Verantwortung für den Themenkatalog: Du steuerst, welche medizinischen Themen wir abdecken – fachübergreifend, evidenzbasiert und mit einem klaren Blick für Versorgungsrelevanz und Lücken im Markt.

data.description:
Dringender Verdacht auf Führungsstärke! Wir ermitteln. Sie liefern die Beweise

als Kaufmännische Leitung (m/w/d) der Simssee Klinik in Bad Endorf

Die Faktenlage: 426 Betten. Rund 560 Mitarbeitende. 6.000 Patientinnen und Patienten im Jahr. 50 Jahre Geschichte. Das nächste Kapitel schreiben Sie.

Wir suchen eine Führungspersönlichkeit, die hohe Ansprüche an Ergebnisse stellt und genauso hohe an die Art, wie sie erreicht werden. Jemanden, der entscheidet, umsetzt und dabei die Menschen mitnimmt, die dieses Haus jeden Tag tragen.

Die Rolle - Die Simssee Klinik verbindet Akutmedizin und Rehabilitation: orthopädische Akutmedizin, orthopädisch-traumatologische und geriatrische Rehabilitation sowie Psychosomatik. Hier treffen unterschiedliche Vergütungswelten, viele Berufsgruppen und anspruchsvolle Steuerungsprozesse aufeinander.

Als kaufmännische Leitung tragen Sie die operative wirtschaftliche und organisatorische Gesamtverantwortung für die Simssee Klinik und die ambulanten Reha- und Gesundheitszentren in Bad Endorf und Rosenheim. Wir erwarten von Ihnen dieselbe unternehmerische Verantwortung wie von einer Geschäftsführung und geben Ihnen dafür eine weitreichende Handlungsvollmacht und echte Entscheidungsspielräume.

Sie berichten direkt an den COO der Gesundheitswelt Chiemgau AG. Ziele und Finanzrahmen vereinbaren wir gemeinsam. Wie Sie daraus vor Ort Ergebnisse machen, entscheiden Sie. Controlling, Personal, IT, Einkauf und Medizincontrolling unterstützen Sie aus der Zentrale.

Der Träger - Die Gesundheitswelt Chiemgau AG ist börsennotiert und mehrheitlich kommunal getragen. Mit rund 1.300 Mitarbeitenden in Medizin und Touristik ist sie fest in der Region verankert. Für Sie heißt das: kurze Wege, ein verlässlicher Rahmen und eine langfristige Perspektive.

Aufgaben

  • Wirtschaftsplanung, Budget, Forecast und Ergebnissteuerung
  • Kapazitäts-, Belegungs- und Aufnahmesteuerung
  • Führung von rund zwölf Leitungsfunktionen, einschließlich der Chefärztinnen und Chefärzte
  • Steuerung von Pflege, Therapie, Service, Küche, Hauswirtschaft und Technik
  • Patientenadministration sowie Zusammenarbeit mit Zuweisern und Kostenträgern
  • Personalplanung, Gewinnung und Bindung von Mitarbeitenden
  • Business Cases, Effizienzprogramme und strategische Projekte, von der Bewertung bis zur Umsetzung
  • Daran messen wir Ihren Erfolg
    Nach zwölf Monaten soll sichtbar sein, was Sie bewegt haben:
  • Kapazitäten werden konsequent genutzt, Belegungspotenziale erkannt und gehoben.
  • Wirtschaftsplan und Forecast werden verlässlich gesteuert.
  • Wirtschaftliche Potenziale sind identifiziert und umgesetzt.
  • Qualität und Patientenzufriedenheit bleiben hoch, auch wenn sich Abläufe ändern.
  • Schlüsselpositionen sind besetzt, gute Leute bleiben, die Teams tragen die Veränderungen mit.
  • Maßnahmen haben klare Verantwortliche, Termine und messbare Ergebnisse.
  • Medizin, Pflege, Therapie, Verwaltung und Konzern arbeiten verbindlich zusammen.

Die Rahmenbedingungen im Gesundheitswesen werden nicht einfacher. Wir suchen niemanden, der darauf wartet, dass es leichter wird. Wir suchen jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt und die Dinge voranbringt: klar in der Sache, respektvoll im Umgang. Gestaltungsfreude inklusive.

Qualifikation

Sie haben mehrjährige kaufmännische Führungserfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, zum Beispiel als kaufmännische Leitung, Verwaltungsleitung, Standortleitung oder Geschäftsführung. Außerdem bringen Sie mit:

  • ein Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Gesundheitsökonomie, des Gesundheits- oder Medizinmanagements oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Sicherheit in Wirtschaftsplanung, Budgetierung, Forecasting und Ergebnissteuerung
  • Kenntnisse der Krankenhaus- oder Rehabilitationsvergütung
  • Erfahrung im Kapazitäts-, Prozess- und Veränderungsmanagement
  • Entscheidungsfreude und Umsetzungsstärke
  • eine klare und wertschätzende Art zu führen, auch gegenüber Chefärztinnen und Chefärzten
  • das Geschick, unterschiedliche Berufsgruppen und Interessen zusammenzuführen
  • unternehmerisches Denken und Lust auf Verantwortung

Benefits

  • unternehmerischer Gestaltungsspielraum mit direkter Wirkung
  • kurze Wege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vorstand
  • ein stabiler, mehrheitlich kommunaler Träger mit langfristiger Perspektive
  • Unterstützung durch die zentralen Bereiche der Gesundheitswelt Chiemgau AG
  • eine markt- und leistungsgerechte Vergütung mit variablem Anteil
  • ein Arbeitsplatz zwischen Chiemsee und Alpen, freier Eintritt in die Chiemgau Thermen inklusive

Anspruchsvoll? Ja. Genau deshalb reizvoll. Ihre Bewerbung: nicht irgendwann. Jetzt.

Schicken Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf und Ihr wichtigstes Beweisstück, die Antwort auf eine Frage: Welche schwierige Situation haben Sie schon einmal gedreht – und was war danach konkret besser?

Nennen Sie uns gern auch Ihre Gehaltsvorstellung und Ihren frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin. Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir selbstverständlich vertraulich.

Ihre Ansprechperson bei Fragen: unser COO Stefan Düvelmeyer, 08053 200104

data.title: Tech Lead: AI & Innovation
data.description:
↳ Alternative locations: Barcelona, Frankfurt a.M., Leipzig, Sevilla

Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – "Vicos". We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SME. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy use). Developing it further takes engineers who combine technical excellence, pragmatic judgement and entrepreneurial spirit. The Tech Lead: AI & Innovation we are looking for embodies these qualities in his or her leadership. He or she is up for making a major contribution to our company and to our society.

Tasks

  • As the most senior engineer, you'll lead, grow and enable a small team of (forward deployed) engineers: hire, onboard, coach and make every engineer successful in their role.
  • Own the technical direction and technology decisions for Vicoland. Set the architecture across the stack, from frontend to infrastructure, and make sure what we build is scalable, robust and maintainable.
  • Stay hands-on: contribute code yourself, build prototypes, and use AI to aggressively ship high-quality software alongside your team.
  • Translate business needs into technical roadmaps in close cooperation with Business Development, Product and other stakeholders. Prioritize, scope and make trade-offs explicit.
  • Own delivery end-to-end for your team: design, development, QA, deployment and production monitoring, with clear engineering standards and quality gates.
  • Establish how we build with AI: best practices for context engineering, model selection, evaluation, tracing and observability, so that quality is measured, not assumed.
  • Run architectural discussions, code reviews and retrospectives; create a culture of ownership, constructive challenge and continuous learning.
  • Act as a sparring partner to the Chief Product Officer and the leadership team on technology strategy, build-vs-buy decisions and team setup.

Requirements

  • Have proven people leadership experience: you have led an engineering team (ideally 3+ engineers), including hiring, performance conversations, career development and coaching.
  • Have excelled somewhere, somehow through an impactful technical contribution, one which we can talk about, and still enjoy writing code yourself.
  • Have deep hands-on experience across the stack (frontend, backend, data, infrastructure/cloud) and a track record of architecting and shipping production-grade software, preferably with AI components (LLMs, embeddings, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, PyTorch/TensorFlow).
  • Have experience developing AI agents and integrating them into business workflows.
  • Be on top of the latest tools, models and trends in AI-assisted software engineering. You are excellent at context engineering (incl. prompting), know when to leverage which model, and have first-hand experience with Claude Code or Cursor, and you know how to roll these practices out across a team.
  • Know how to evaluate what gets built. You can design eval sets, work with LLM-as-judge or ground-truth data, use tracing and observability tooling to find and fix regressions, and make evaluation a team habit.
  • Practice a truly agnostic approach to stack and tools: you pick the right tech for the problem, not vice versa, and can explain your choices to both engineers and business stakeholders.
  • Balance autonomy and alignment: you drive your team from idea to finished product independently, while knowing when to involve, align with or escalate to others.
  • Have the ability to thoughtfully challenge ideas and drive constructive discussions with engineers, product owners, the Chief Product Officer and business leadership.
  • Lead with humility: you create psychological safety, give and receive honest feedback, and measure your success by the success of your team.
  • Reside within ±3 hours of Central European Time (to enable effective collaboration), at best in one of our office locations in Barcelona, Berlin, Frankfurt, Leipzig, and Sevilla.
  • Full professional proficiency in English at C2 level.
  • Professional proficiency in German at C1 level.

Bonus

  • Experience building or scaling an engineering team in a startup or scale-up environment.
  • Prior experience integrating AI into SaaS business workflows, ideally in a client-facing or forward-deployed setup.
  • Familiarity with the modern AI-tooling ecosystem (agents, memory systems, vector databases, orchestration frameworks).
  • Experience working with distributed or multi-location teams.

Benefits

  • You’ll work in an international, closely knit team of high‑performers and entrepreneurial spirits.
  • Remote‑friendly + flexible work hours.
  • Excellent compensation + participation in the company through our ESOP.
  • Growth mindset: Hard skills are important — but mindset matters more. If you meet most of the requirements and you’re hungry to learn, apply anyway.

If you’re a high‑impact tech lead who thrives on autonomy, drives real results, and is passionate about applying AI to change how teams work - let’s talk. Even if you don’t check every bullet above, but you bring exceptional drive, creativity, and a growth mindset, please apply. We believe the right mindset counts more than checkboxes.

data.title: Social Media Recruiter (m/w/d) Minijob (Homeoffice)
data.description:
Beutler Saghari & Partner ist eine bundesweit tätige Headhunting-Agentur mit Sitz in Iserlohn und Gummersbach.Unsere besondere Stärke liegt in der telefonischen Direktansprache – diskret, verbindlich und erfolgreich.

Doch wir wissen: Erfolgreiches Recruiting bedeutet heute, alle relevanten Wege zu nutzen. Deshalb ergänzen wir unsere bewährte Direktansprache gezielt um Social Media Recruiting um auch dort die besten Kandidaten für unsere Mandanten zu finden.

Für den Ausbau verschiedener Business Units, suchen wir daher eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die Social Media Recruiting wirklich versteht – jemand, der weiß, wo die passenden Profile zu finden sind und wie man sie überzeugend anspricht.

Aufgaben

Identifikation und aktive Ansprache von Fach- und Führungskräften über LinkedIn, Xing, Facebook und Instagram

  • Entwicklung passgenauer Suchstrategien (Boolesche Operatoren, Keyword-Kombinationen, Zielgruppen-Research)
  • Vereinbarung von Terminen für unsere Berater
  • Durchführung erster telefonischer Interviews

Qualifikation

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Social Media Recruiting, idealerweise im Umfeld Tax, Legal oder Finance
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Plattform-Tools wie LinkedIn Recruiter oder Xing Talentmanager
  • Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise im Homeoffice
  • Hohe Eigenmotivation und Gespür für Menschen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office

Benefits

  • Flexible Tätigkeit im Homeoffice mit freier Zeiteinteilung
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Kollegiales, professionelles Umfeld mit klaren Prozessen und offener Kommunikation
  • Option auf Teilzeit- oder Vollzeitanstellung bei erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit

Wir suchen keine Social Media Manager, sondern Recruiter, die Social Media aktiv zur Kandidatengewinnung nutzen. Keine Anzeigenkampagnen – sondern echtes Recruiting über Netzwerke.

Wenn Sie Freude daran haben, über soziale Netzwerke die passenden Talente zu finden, aktiv anzusprechen und unsere Direktansprache gezielt zu ergänzen, dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

data.title: Graphic Designer (m/w/d) – Social Media & YouTube Thumbnails (Minijob)
data.description:
Gestalte den Look der größten Neuro-Personenmarke Deutschlands

Wir haben ein klares Ziel: die größte Personenmarke für Neurowissenschaft in Deutschland aufzubauen. Hinter Henry Hildebrandt stehen über 500.000 Follower auf Instagram, ein SPIEGEL-Bestseller und TEDx-Auftritte, und genau diese Reichweite willst du mit deinen Designs weiter wachsen lassen. Als Teil unseres Marketing- und Social-Media-Teams gestaltest du Grafiken für unsere Kanäle und kümmerst dich um die YouTube-Thumbnails, die darüber entscheiden, ob ein Video geklickt wird. Im ersten Monat lernst du unsere Marke und Gestaltungsrichtlinien kennen und setzt direkt deine ersten eigenen Thumbnails um. Die Stelle ist als unbefristeter Minijob (geringfügige Beschäftigung) mit rund 10 Stunden pro Woche ausgelegt und komplett remote.

Das erwartet dich

  • Konzeption und Design von aufmerksamkeitsstarken YouTube-Thumbnails

  • Erstellung von Bild- und Grafikmaterial für verschiedene Social-Media-Kanäle

  • Weiterentwicklung unseres visuellen Auftritts in Abstimmung mit dem Team

Was du mitbringst

  • Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Designprogrammen wie Photoshop oder Figma

  • Gespür für aktuelle Trends auf YouTube und Social Media

  • Erfahrung in der Erstellung von digitalen Inhalten

  • Selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

Wenn du dich in den Anforderungen wiederfindest und Lust hast, visuelle Akzente zu setzen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – auch wenn du nicht jeden Punkt zu hundert Prozent erfüllst.
