The Fincrime Product team builds and maintains the platform that protects LemFi and its customers from sanctions breaches, money laundering and fraud. As our Rules Modeller / FinCrime Analyst, you are the bridge between financial-crime risk and the systems that detect it: you own the tuning, thresholds and risk-scoring logic that decide what gets flagged, and you own the evidence that proves those decisions are sound.

This is a domain-led role on a small, senior team. You will spend your time in typologies, alert data and detection logic - reducing false positives without letting real risk slip through - working closely with Compliance, Investigations, Product and Engineering. Your tuning directly shapes both our operational cost and our regulatory posture across more than 21 countries and dozens of corridors.

What you'll build and own

  • Tune and maintain risk-scoring parameters, transaction-monitoring rules and screening match thresholds to reduce false positives while preserving coverage - and document every change with audit-ready evidence.

  • Analyse alert output and case feedback to recommend, test and implement threshold and logic changes; run above-the-line / below-the-line testing and periodic tuning cycles.

  • Translate emerging money-laundering, sanctions-evasion and fraud typologies into detection scenarios and rules, with clear written rationale and coverage assessments against LemFi's cross-border corridors.

  • Tune name and entity matching logic for sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening across onboarding and ongoing checks; maintain customer and transaction risk-scoring segmentation aligned to risk appetite.

  • Build and interpret MI on alert volumes, false-positive rates and conversion to cases and SARs; produce tuning reports that leadership, auditors and regulators can rely on.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to specify changes, with Investigations for feedback loops, and with Compliance and the MLRO for policy and risk-appetite alignment.

  • Support internal audit, model-validation exercises and regulatory exams with a maintained, evidence-backed change log.

Your experience

  • Around 3 to 5 years in financial crime - transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and/or fraud - at a bank, fintech, payments provider or PSP.

  • Hands-on experience configuring or tuning TM and/or screening systems: rules, scenarios, matching logic or thresholds, not just reviewing outputs.

  • Solid working knowledge of AML/CTF, sanctions and fraud typologies and the regulatory expectations around monitoring and screening governance.

  • Comfortable working with data: reading and interpreting alert and transaction data, slicing it in spreadsheets, and using basic SQL to pull what you need (or a clear and demonstrated appetite to build that skill quickly).

  • Strong analytical and documentation skills - able to evidence and defend a tuning decision to an auditor or examiner in plain language.

  • A clear communicator who can translate between risk and systems, working across compliance, product and engineering without losing accuracy.

Nice to have

  • Experience in cross-border remittance, multi-corridor payments or a PSP operating across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Exposure to specific TM or screening vendors, and/or familiarity with Python or analysis notebooks.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

Almost any company can produce training video at scale today. Almost none can tell you whether it actually made someone better at their job. We're building the product that closes that gap: an agentic, real-time experience where people practice live, dynamic scenarios, and where organizations finally get genuine signal on readiness, instead of a metric tied to course completion. This is a zero-to-one bet on what comes after content, which is practice, and proof.

You'll own one of two of the domains inside that bet, Surveys and Guidance, from strategy through ship.

Why now

Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it.

The problem you're solving

Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal.

We have the underlying technology to change that. What we need is a product manager who can turn it into something an enterprise will use to prepare its people, and that an end user actually wants to engage with, across two connected domains:

  • Surveys - capturing structured, trustworthy signal at scale: how people feel, how they're performing, and where the gaps are.

  • Guidance - giving people direction in the moment they need it, live and in context, rather than as a debrief after the fact.

Both sit inside the same bet: give organizations proof of readiness, not just proof of attendance.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the multi-quarter strategy for Surveys and Guidance, setting the direction, identifying the right problems to solve, and making the trade-offs needed to deliver against them.

  • Defining and evolving the success metrics for both domains, and connecting product outcomes directly to commercial results: retention, expansion, and revenue impact.

  • Getting close to the customers who matter most: understanding how they think, where current tools leave them exposed, and translating that into a product direction others can act on.

  • Driving a shared understanding of where these product areas are going and why. Engineering, design, R&D, and commercial counterparts should all be able to articulate the strategy and the reasoning behind it.

  • Producing written narratives, strategy docs, and PRDs, that move decisions forward and give your team the context to build the right thing without a follow-up conversation.

  • Balancing short-term delivery with long-term product health: scoping to reflect execution risk, hitting milestones predictably, and iterating based on evidence rather than opinion.

  • Contributing to improvements in product practice across the team, and actively participating in PM hiring.

Who you are

You've owned a critical product domain before, one where the stakes were real and the strategy was yours to set, not just execute. You're comfortable operating with autonomy on the what, not just the how, and you have a track record of connecting product decisions to commercial outcomes.

You understand that zero-to-one products in complex domains require you to hold two things at once: the discipline to deliver predictably in the short term, and the judgment to make the right long-term bets while the evidence is still forming. You don't wait for a clean brief. You identify the right problems, form a view, and bring others along.

You're a strong written communicator. Engineering and design partners, commercial leads, and senior leadership should all come away from your docs and updates with a clear understanding of where the domain is going and why, without needing to ask.

You care about the quality of the experience. Real-time, agentic products are unforgiving, and you hold a high bar for what "good" feels like, for the user in the moment and for the customer looking at outcomes.

You may be a good fit if you bring

  • Significant experience in product management, with direct experience owning a critical product domain: setting strategy, not just executing it.

  • A track record of connecting product outcomes to commercial results: ARR, retention, expansion, or equivalent.

  • Experience with zero-to-one product development in a complex, experience-driven space. You've navigated the ambiguity of a zero-to-one build and have the scar tissue to show for it.

  • Experience building agentic or AI-powered products. You understand what makes real-time AI interactions feel natural, and what breaks them.

  • Strong written communication: strategy docs, PRDs, and decision memos that others can act on without a follow-up conversation.

  • Experience working alongside enterprise buying motions. You'll be close to the commercial team, and that context matters.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. Strong candidates rarely match a list exactly, and we'd rather hear from you.

Location

Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

 

Global benefits:

  • You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity.

  • You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.

  • Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person.

  • Work from home budget

  • Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year

  • Generous referral scheme

  • Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater - our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit)

 

Benefits specific to UK:

  • Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants

  • 5% pension match

  • Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the office

  • Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality
data.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage.

  • Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control.

  • Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them.

  • Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities.

  • Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest.

  • Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step down from development.

  • Production experience building test infrastructure, developer tooling or internal platforms that other engineers depend on — designed and owned, not just extended.

  • Hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks: prompt and context design, tool use, handling non-determinism, and evaluating output quality. This is the differentiator for the role.

  • Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing.

  • The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLM systems.

  • Open-source contribution experience.

  • Java, TypeScript or Python; Kubernetes and Helm.

  • Background in developer tooling or platform engineering.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-AG1 #LI-Remote #USEAST

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00

United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00

Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00

Canada: C$152,700.00 to C$251,200.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face.

We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry. 
 
Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us

Title: Director, EMEA Insights

Status: Hybrid

Department: Global Insights

Location: UK Office

Reporting Relationship: VP, Global Insights

Position Summary

e.l.f. Beauty is looking for a Director, EMEA Insights to join our dynamic, fast-paced, high-growth company. The ideal candidate will have a consumer and community-first mindset with a strong background in executing consumer research and synthesizing market data to analyze and articulate consumer trends and business impacts. This person is highly self-motivated, inherently curious, and strategic yet detail-oriented, with a passion for analyzing data, surfacing insights, and storytelling with data to drive business decisions.

The position will report directly to the Vice President, Global Insights. 

The Director, EMEA Insights is responsible for overseeing the EMEA-focused market and consumer insights functions, including market analysis, competitive intelligence, product insights, consumer research, audience segmentation, trends, and foresight, to drive actionable, data-driven growth through compelling storytelling. This individual will be adept at connecting dots across multiple data sources and strategically distilling and disseminating those actionable insights to all levels in the organization. This individual will be a thought leader and work collaboratively with cross-functional partners, acting as the voice of the EMEA consumer in making strategic connections between broad-based trends and marketplace opportunities. The ideal candidate is data-driven, results-oriented, has excellent communication skills, and is comfortable operating across all levels of the business, from strategic to tactical.

This position is based in e.l.f.’s London office with a hybrid 3-day in office schedule.

Responsibilities:

  • Strategically distill insights from diverse data sources and present them to senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams in a compelling narrative with concise and actionable findings and implications.
  • Leverage multiple data sources to connect dots and develop a comprehensive understanding of the business environment including brand performance, competitive brands and products, social dynamics, consumer behavior, demographic/audience factors, and macroeconomics, keeping a pulse on consistently evolving trends and foresight within and beyond beauty. Disseminate insights and strategic recommendations throughout the organization at all levels.
  • Leverage syndicated data tracking resources (e.g. NielsenIQ, Circana, Euromonitor, WGSN, Shopper Insights, Mintel, Spate, GfK) for frequent analysis of trends and identifying whitespace opportunities.
  • Lead the evolving EMEA consumer profile and audience segmentation initiatives across the brand portfolio.
  • Analyze social media conversations and trends, translating to actionable recommendations for marketing teams.
  • Own end-to-end creation of Insights presentations (e.g., PowerPoint), i.e., from storyline through final edits.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders in brand, innovation, digital, creative, sales, and Integrated Marketing Communications functions, surfacing insights and analytics to further promote and enable consumer-centric, data-driven decision-making in EMEA markets.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with external data and research partners (NielsenIQ, Circana, Mintel, YouGov, etc.), while consistently evaluating potential new data and research partners.
  • Drive the exploration and implementation of innovative research, trend tracking and social listening methodologies, including AI, to create next generation insights approaches and methodologies.
  • Partner with US-based Global Insights team to connect dots and unify insights that drive the business.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in consumer research, market analysis, and data insights and analytics, inclusive of experience leading a multi-disciplinary consumer and market insights team.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Marketing, or a related quantitative field. A master's degree or MBA is a plus.
  • Strong ability to analyze and synthesize disparate information from multiple data sources into a holistic story with strategic implications and recommendations. Capable of turning complex information into simple and understandable messaging.
  • Adept at designing and executing multi-country end-to-end quantitative and qualitative consumer research (i.e., survey development, discussion moderation), with the ability to generate relevant and actionable insights connected to consumer needs and business strategies.
  • Experience with multiple types of custom research, including positioning, segmentation, innovation concepts, advertising/concept testing, consumer journeys, path to purchase, brand health tracking, etc.
  • Outstanding ability to navigate syndicated data sets (e.g., NielsenIQ, Circana, Euromonitor, GfK, Shopper Insights) beyond pulling numbers, to analyze and distill the most relevant insights.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to work independently and effectively across multiple projects, without sacrificing accuracy and attention to detail, in an extremely fast-paced environment.
  • Inherently curious, proactive, and enjoys digging beyond the surface to uncover insights. Exceptional at finding trends and the story in the data, articulating the “so what,” and translating insights into strategic, actionable recommendations.
  • Passionate about customer-centricity and data-driven strategy, with the ability to effectively communicate and influence key stakeholders.
  • Outstanding analytical, critical thinking, and organizational skills with extreme attention to detail. Ability to focus on both strategy and execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and data story-telling skills, including the ability to clearly present findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholders. Has executive presence with a high degree of comfort working with and presenting to senior leaders.
  • Adept at utilizing AI tools for efficiency and enhanced deliverables.
  • Thrives in ambiguity, with strong prioritization and project management skills.
  • Localized knowledge of EMEA regions to surface local trends and execute relevant research.
  • Proficient in MS Office core suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
  • Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
  • Experience using data analytics tools and languages such as SQL, SPSS, etc.
  • Consumer goods industry experience preferred.
  • Passionate about the beauty industry.

Total compensation includes base salary, annual company-based performance bonus, and equity. Under e.l.f.’s annual bonus program, employees are eligible to earn up to 200% of their target bonus when company performance exceeds defined goals. In addition, e.l.f. provides a variety of other benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a retirement savings plan, gender neutral parental leave, and unlimited paid time off. data.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
data.description:
About Level Zero

Level Zero is pioneering next-generation biosensor technology for precise, real-time monitoring of critical endocrine biomarkers. Recognised as one of the top 20 startups across all categories worldwide at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024 - and backed by top-tier organisations like SOSV and Entrepreneur First - we're pushing the boundaries of biochemistry and nanotechnology to revolutionize personalised health.

Founded by two seasoned engineers, we bring extensive experience in R&D, technical innovation, and commercial strategy to transform the way people monitor their health. Our mission is bold: to revolutionise health management by delivering clinical-grade data directly to individuals, wherever they are.

We're seeking driven innovators to join us in pushing the boundaries of biosensing and health tech, making personalised health monitoring a reality for everyone. To achieve this ambitious vision, we're assembling the best team in the world - dedicated to turning cutting-edge science into life-changing, real-world solutions.

We're looking for a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to lead the mechanical architecture of Level Zero's wearable medical devices, from early concept through to design transfer and volume manufacture. Working directly with the founding team and a multidisciplinary engineering group, you'll set the mechanical direction for highly miniaturised, body-worn products, making the key decisions on architecture, materials, manufacturing processes and risk. This is a hands-on senior role for someone who wants to own the mechanical design of a medical wearable end to end, while mentoring others and shaping how we develop products as we grow.


What you'll do
  • Own and lead the mechanical architecture of Level Zero's wearable medical devices.
  • Drive miniaturisation and integration, working with electronics, sensing and industrial design to package complex functionality into small, comfortable, body-worn form factors.
  • Set mechanical design standards, CAD practices, drawing conventions and design review processes for the engineering team.
  • Lead the design of injection moulded, overmoulded and precision components from concept through to production release.
  • Define mechanical requirements, design specifications and architecture documentation, and ensure traceability within the design history file.
  • Lead tolerance analysis and statistical tolerancing for critical assemblies to ensure robust performance and manufacturability at scale.
  • Own mechanical risk management, leading DFMEA activities and contributing to PFMEA and overall product risk files.

  • The chance to grow with us, including ample opportunities for leadership, career advancement, and exploration.

data.title: Technical Program Manager (Science)
data.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.



The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with a strong technical or scientific background (Natural Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering and/or AI/ML) to join our team in Cambridge or London. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates cutting-edge scientific research and tool/model development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our internal technical teams on coordinating complex scientific campaigns and also manage scoping and delivery of high-stakes customer projects. You will also be involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles and improvements to end to end technical delivery.


What You Will Do

Program Leadership & Research Integration

  • Lead internal technical programs across frontier research, AI/ML model development, data workflows, and machine learning infrastructure, acting as the connective tissue between materials scientists, AI researchers and engineers.

  • Translate scientific and business objectives into executable plans, aligning commercial, research and engineering teams.

  • Close the loop between experimental results and the AI research cycle, translating lab findings back into the model development process to continuously improve accuracy and accelerate discovery.

  • Own planning and delivery of projects; calculating compute, managing resources & dependencies, mapping out timelines, and managing risks to ensure successful outcomes.

Partner & Customer Collaboration

  • Lead technical programs with industry partners and research institutions, serving as a primary program contact for our external partners during the execution and delivery of projects.

  • Facilitate technical discussions between internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Drive project scoping and proposal writing in collaboration with the partnerships and technical teams.

  • Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment.

Process & Operations

  • Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes.

  • Implement metrics for tracking technical milestones and program outcomes.

  • Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs.

  • Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes.

  • Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation.

  • Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer facing processes.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You possess a strong background in a Natural Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or related field.

  • Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager in a scientific or AI/ML environment, with a clear sense of where the opportunities and challenges in the field lie.

  • Technical fluency across model architecture, cloud infrastructure, and the software development lifecycle.

  • Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams.

  • The ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity and maintain cohesion across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, Chemistry, and Engineering).

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both highly technical researchers and non-technical partners at varying levels of seniority.

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.

  • Experience managing technical external-facing customer projects.


Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Practical experience or an academic background in Materials Science, Experimental Chemistry, or Physics.

  • Hands-on experience with high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure or scientific data management.

  • Experience with molecular simulation software, quantum chemistry packages, or cheminformatics tools.

Additional Considerations

This role will be based in our London or Cambridge office, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations (Amsterdam and Berlin) for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Implementation, and Support teams to deliver an excellent customer experience

  • A strong sense of ownership; you are hands-on, data-driven, and highly skilled in relationship management

What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed Experience…

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Transit benefit if you travel by public transport to the office 

  • Healthy snacks and after-work socials organised by the company

  • Health, Dental and Optical cover

 

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality
data.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage.

  • Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control.

  • Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them.

  • Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities.

  • Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest.

  • Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step down from development.

  • Production experience building test infrastructure, developer tooling or internal platforms that other engineers depend on — designed and owned, not just extended.

  • Hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks: prompt and context design, tool use, handling non-determinism, and evaluating output quality. This is the differentiator for the role.

  • Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing.

  • The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLM systems.

  • Open-source contribution experience.

  • Java, TypeScript or Python; Kubernetes and Helm.

  • Background in developer tooling or platform engineering.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-AG1 #LI-Remote #USEAST

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00

United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00

Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00

Canada: C$152,700.00 to C$251,200.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

data.title: Professional Services Engineer - Cloudflare Implementation
data.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Application Security & Performance and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across Europe, the Gulf and Asia, with operations spanning Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist focus and technical expertise with the scale, stability and career opportunities of a major international organisation.

The Role

As a Professional Services Engineer, you will design, build and implement Cloudflare environments for BRIXIO's French-speaking enterprise and public-sector clients and help take them successfully into production.

This is a hands-on implementation role covering onboarding, migration from existing CDN and WAF platforms, WAF and DDoS deployment, Zero Trust rollout, DNS cutovers, SASE and production hardening.

You will work within properly planned and governed client projects. The Delivery Manager owns the project plan and delivery governance, while the Principal Architect provides technical authority and owns the overall design.

Your responsibility is the build, validation and client-facing technical implementation.

The client portfolio includes French banks, industrial groups, public bodies and media organisations. You will regularly work directly with their technical teams in French, explaining what you are implementing, why particular decisions have been made and how production changes will be managed.

This is not a back-office engineering role.

We are hiring at two levels:

  • Senior Engineer: capable of owning a Cloudflare migration end to end and independently leading technical conversations with clients.
  • Mid-Level Engineer: strong network/security fundamentals and implementation experience, with the opportunity to deepen Cloudflare expertise through structured training and certification.

What You Will Do

Cloudflare Implementation & Migration

  • Configure and deploy Cloudflare environments across DNS, CDN and caching, WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, load balancing, Bot Management, Zero Trust and Access, tunnels and SASE components.
  • Deliver migrations from incumbent platforms, particularly Akamai and other CDN/WAF providers.
  • Handle rule translation, traffic cutover planning, staged deployment and rollback design.
  • Plan and execute production DNS cutovers, ensuring a validated rollback is available at every stage.
  • Build and deliver pilots and proofs of concept, from individual applications through to full production rollouts.
  • Test, validate and tune deployed environments, including cache-hit ratio, latency, WAF false positives and other client-relevant performance characteristics.

Client-Facing Technical Delivery

  • Lead technical working sessions with client teams in French, including workshops, configuration reviews, cutover rehearsals and go-live calls.
  • Explain technical decisions, risks and implementation considerations clearly to both engineers and management stakeholders.
  • Produce client-facing technical documentation in French and English, including configuration records, runbooks, cutover plans and project-closure documentation.
  • Identify and raise technical or delivery risks as soon as they become visible rather than allowing them to surface late in the project.

Working Within the Delivery Model

  • Work according to the project plan established by the Delivery Manager.
  • Provide clear and accurate progress updates and flag potential delays or blockers early.
  • Escalate architecture and design questions to the Principal Architect rather than making unapproved architectural changes during delivery.
  • Maintain accurate project timesheets and record effort against the appropriate projects.
  • Identify and communicate potential out-of-scope client requests to the Delivery Manager.
  • Deliver a structured handover into managed services at project closure, including complete documentation, runbooks and known risks, allowing the support team to operate the environment effectively from day one.

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Work with implementation engineers in Dubai and Poland, managed services teams in Morocco and the Philippines, and pre-sales and architecture teams in France.
  • Use Zoho Projects and BrixioOne as the source of truth for project tasks, documentation and reporting.
  • Contribute to BRIXIO's internal knowledge base and reusable implementation patterns and playbooks.
  • Support managed services teams with escalations requiring deeper implementation expertise.
  • Share technical knowledge across the wider delivery organisation.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Technical Foundation

You should have a strong practical understanding of:

  • DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS and certificates
  • Proxies and reverse proxies
  • Caching and CDN mechanics
  • Web application architecture
  • Origin infrastructure
  • Cloud fundamentals across AWS, Azure or GCP

You should be able to clearly explain what happens between a browser and an origin infrastructure and confidently troubleshoot problems across that path.

You will also need a solid grounding in web application security, including:

  • WAF concepts
  • OWASP Top 10
  • Bot mitigation
  • DDoS attack patterns
  • Rate limiting

You should be comfortable using technical troubleshooting tools including:

  • curl
  • dig
  • traceroute
  • Browser developer tools

data.title: MSP Engineer, Network and Security - Rotating shifts
data.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Core Services and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across the Gulf, Europe and Asia, with offices in Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist focus and technical expertise with the scale, stability and career opportunities of a major international organisation.

The Role

BRIXIO is building a genuine managed services capability — not simply a ticket queue.

As an MSP Engineer, you will operate client Cloudflare environments during your shift, combining reactive incident management with structured, proactive engineering.

You will detect and investigate issues before clients report them, resolve incidents within committed service levels, execute production changes under controlled processes, and carry out proactive activities designed to improve security, performance and service stability over time.

Managed services and support are delivered by the same team. This means your role spans both incident response and scheduled proactive work, with proactive engineering time protected within the rota rather than fitted around ticket volume.

You will be the technical responder on shift, but you will not carry an account alone. Client relationship management and reporting are owned by the Delivery Manager, while technical arbitration sits with the MSP & Support Lead.

There is no expectation to be reachable outside your scheduled shift.

Working Pattern

BRIXIO operates a follow-the-sun model across its teams in Morocco and the Philippines, designed around client demand and defined service coverage windows.

Early Shift

09:00–17:00 Morocco time

Provides full coverage during the core client peak window and is named on relevant client contracts.

Late Shift

15:00–23:00 Morocco time

Extends coverage across the peak window and includes an overlap and structured handover with the Early Shift.

Weekend Rotation

Weekend coverage is shared across the team on a reduced rotation. Sunday forms part of the service window for Gulf clients.

Shifts are managed through a published rota issued in advance, so you will know your schedule ahead of time.

Each shift change includes a 30-minute overlap and written handover, ensuring that engineers do not inherit undocumented situations.

Under the current operating model, Gulf night coverage is provided by colleagues in the Philippines within their normal working day. Shift patterns may evolve as the team and client base grow, with any changes discussed with the team in advance.

Weekend rotation is compensated in accordance with Moroccan law and Equans policy.

What You Will Do

Service Operations

  • Staff the client intake channel during your shift, qualify and triage incoming requests, and own first response within committed service levels.
  • Diagnose and resolve incidents across the Cloudflare stack, including WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, bot management, CDN and caching, DNS, TLS, load balancing, Zero Trust and Workers.
  • Qualify monitoring alerts, act on them using documented runbooks and create tickets where required.
  • Escalate appropriately and early to senior engineers, the MSP & Support Lead and Cloudflare Support in accordance with the escalation matrix.
  • Maintain accurate ticket records in Jira, including detection source, priority and timestamps, supporting accurate service-level reporting.

Change Execution

  • Execute production configuration changes under formal change control, including four-eyes validation and a documented rollback plan before deployment.
  • Provide named technical coverage during declared client go-live windows, including pre-go-live validation and active monitoring following cutover.
  • Maintain Cloudflare configuration as code using Terraform and version control.
  • Investigate and resolve configuration drift identified through automated nightly comparisons.
  • Ensure production changes are properly documented and traceable.

Proactive Engineering

  • Deliver scheduled proactive activities including configuration and security-posture audits, false-positive analysis, cache and rate-limit calibration, DNS and certificate hygiene, and unused-rule cleanup.
  • Analyse traffic and security telemetry using Cloudflare Analytics, GraphQL API and log data to identify potential problems before they affect clients.
  • Recommend and implement security and performance improvements and demonstrate their impact.
  • Contribute to root-cause analysis following major incidents.
  • Identify recurring causes and raise them through the problem-management process so they can be eliminated rather than repeatedly resolved.

Collaboration & Knowledge

  • Work closely with client NOC and security teams, including participation in operational channels and major incident bridges where BRIXIO is integrated with the client's teams.
  • Write and maintain runbooks, Standard Operating Procedures and configuration documentation in Confluence.
  • Support BRIXIO's professional services and implementation teams during escalations and handovers into managed service.
  • Actively share technical knowledge across the team to reduce dependency on individual engineers.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Technical Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in network, security or cloud operations.
  • Experience within managed services, NOC or SOC environments is a strong advantage.
  • Solid working knowledge of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, caching and CDN mechanics.
  • Practical Cloudflare experience across WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, bot management, CDN and DNS.
  • Where Cloudflare experience is partial, BRIXIO will fund Cloudflare certification, which you will be expected to complete within the first six months.
  • Confidence using diagnostic tools including curl, dig, traceroute, browser developer tools and HAR analysis.
  • Experience with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with Git/version control.
  • Scripting capability using Python or Bash.
  • Understanding of web application architecture and application-security fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with Jira Service Management and ITIL-aligned incident, change and problem-management processes.
  • Exposure to observability and monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP is an advantage.

Languages

Full professional fluency in both French and English is a hard requirement.

You will handle incidents both in writing and verbally with French- and English-speaking enterprise clients, including during high-pressure situations. You will also prepare client-facing incident and change records in both languages.

Both French and English will be assessed during the interview process.

Arabic is a significant advantage when supporting BRIXIO's Gulf accounts.

How You Work

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Calm and methodical when working under incident pressure.
  • Disciplined about escalation rather than improvising when the situation requires additional expertise.
  • Serious about documentation and maintaining accurate technical records.
  • Able to explain technical situations clearly to non-technical stakeholders in either French or English.
  • Comfortable acknowledging what they do not know and finding the right answer.
  • Reliable within a rotating shift environment and disciplined about providing clean handovers to colleagues.
  • Comfortable working remotely within a distributed international team spanning Morocco, the Philippines, France and the Gulf.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Increasing numbers of issues are detected and resolved proactively before clients report them.
  • Service-level commitments are consistently met, with any breaches accurately documented and understood.
  • Recurring incidents are progressively eliminated, reducing reactive workload over time.
  • Production changes are executed safely, with rollback plans prepared even when they are not needed.
  • Shift handovers are clean, tickets are accurate and runbooks remain current.
  • Clients develop confidence in the engineers operating their environments.
  • Proactive engineering contributes measurably to improved security, performance and service stability.

Why BRIXIO?

  • Join one of a select number of Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partners, working directly with Cloudflare engineering and support teams.
  • Be part of Equans and the Bouygues group, with the stability, scale and career mobility of a major international organisation.
  • Develop genuine Cloudflare depth through access to Cloudflare University, partner-only training and funded certification.
  • Join a managed service designed around defined processes, published rotas, protected proactive engineering time and no expectation of being reachable outside your shift.
  • Develop towards Senior MSP Engineering, Professional Services Implementation, Solution Architecture or Service Delivery Management.
  • Work in an environment where automation is part of the engineering role, with engineers encouraged to contribute to and improve BRIXIO's internal tooling.

About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Application Security & Performance and Cloudflare One.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist Cloudflare expertise with the scale and reach of a major international organisation.

The Role

As BRIXIO continues to grow, we are looking for a Customer Success & Renewals Manager to take ownership of the commercial health and long-term development of our managed service and support portfolio.

This is not a technical support or project management position.

Your focus begins where implementation projects transition into long-term client relationships. You will own renewals, retention, account health and the conversion of completed projects into ongoing support and managed services.

You will develop a clear understanding of every account in your portfolio: the value being delivered, the health of the relationship, upcoming renewals, potential risks and opportunities for further development.

This is a newly created role with genuine ownership. You will have the opportunity to build the processes, governance and structure behind BRIXIO's customer success and renewal function.

What You Will Own

Renewals & Retention

  • Own the consolidated renewal calendar across Cloudflare subscriptions and BRIXIO service contracts.

  • Use subscription renewals as an opportunity to review usage, entitlement, service requirements and potential managed-service needs.
  • Maintain accurate renewal forecasts across the portfolio.
  • Build and maintain an account-health view using service performance, ticket trends, incidents, consumption and stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify accounts at risk and coordinate recovery plans with the relevant operational teams.
  • Review lost renewals and ensure relevant insights are captured and acted upon.

Project-to-Service Conversion

Client Governance & Account Health

Account Growth

Commercial Operations & Collaboration

  • Work across BRIXIO's international organisation, collaborating with operations and support, sales, architecture, pre-sales and finance teams.

  • Establish scalable processes and ways of working for a newly created function.
  • Bring structure and visibility to the portfolio as BRIXIO continues to grow.

Your initial priorities will be clearly defined:

  • Portfolio baseline: establish the position of every managed service and support contract, including value, renewal date, account health, stakeholders and risk.

  • Conversion pipeline: review recently completed and closing implementation projects and build a qualified project-to-service conversion pipeline.
  • Service consumption: take ownership of prepaid and on-demand service contracts and improve utilisation.
  • Governance: establish the Quarterly Business Review cycle and reporting structure for major accounts.

  • 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Service Delivery Management or a comparable client-facing commercial role within technology services.

  • Experience within an MSP, managed security provider, systems integrator, consultancy or SaaS environment involving recurring revenue.

  • Experience with vendor subscriptions or licence renewals within a reseller or indirect model would be a strong advantage.
  • Experience creating or developing a customer-success, renewal or account-management function would also be highly valued.

Technical Understanding

You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable having credible conversations with security and infrastructure stakeholders.

Ideally, you will have:

  • A working understanding of DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation and Zero Trust, or the ability to develop this knowledge quickly.

Languages

Full professional fluency in French and English is essential, both written and spoken.

You will work with French-speaking European accounts as well as enterprise and public-sector clients across the Gulf, including leading governance conversations and preparing client-facing material in both languages.

Arabic is a significant advantage for the Gulf portfolio.

What Will Help You Succeed

You are likely to thrive in this role if you are:

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured through tangible commercial and customer outcomes, including:

Why BRIXIO?

data.title: Data Scientist (Contract)
data.description:
Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

We are accelerating. The product works, clients renew, the market is taking shape. Every day, shoppers talk to AI agents before they buy, and conversion has been at the heart of how we build the product from day one. We now want to go further and faster, with someone fully dedicated to understanding what turns a conversation into a purchase, and to proving it with data.

As our freelance Data Scientist, full-time, you will dig into everything we have and tell us what drives conversion, what to change in the product next, and how to prove it. You will build on the work already done, challenge it, and find the levers we have not seen yet. You will work directly with the founders and the product and engineering teams.

Understand what drives conversion

  • Explore every data source we have: natural-language conversations, behavioural events, conversion tracking, product and advertiser metadata

  • Turn raw conversations into usable signals (intents, categories, features) that you define and build

  • Link what our agents say (answers, recommendations, tone) to what users do next, and turn it into concrete improvements for the agent team

  • Find the next levers that move purchases, and size the impact of each one

Experiment

  • Turn your findings into prioritised hypotheses the product team can act on

  • Design the A/B tests that validate them, then read the results

  • The engineering team implements the variants: you do not write production code

Strengthen what we measure

  • Spot the remaining blind spots in what we measure and specify the events and properties we are missing, for the engineering team to implement

Profile

Must-have

  • 4+ years of hands-on data science or analytics, with analyses that changed a product or business decision.

  • Advanced SQL and Python for data

  • Strong statistics and experimentation: A/B test design, causal reasoning, and the judgment to separate real effects from noise, selection bias and measurement artifacts, and to know when the data is too thin to conclude

  • Autonomous: you find the right questions in an open problem

  • AI-forward: you use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, agents) daily

  • Fluent French and professional English

  • Available now, full-time

A plus

  • NLP on real text data: classification, clustering, LLM-based labelling

  • E-commerce or retail experience

  • Conversion, CRO or funnel analytics

  • BigQuery, PostHog

  • Adtech or performance-marketing measurement (attribution, ROAS)

  • Familiarity with ranking, recommendations or search relevance

  • Startup experience

No school requirement.

The mission

  • Freelance, full-time, starting ASAP

  • 1 month minimum, around 3 months expected

  • For the right person, the mission can turn into a permanent role

  • Our data stack: BigQuery, PostHog, Python

Why join us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

  • Work directly with an experienced team: two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG)

  • Be part of the next structural shift of the web: agentic interfaces

  • Own mission-critical topics, grow fast, and shape the company's future trajectory

data.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 
 

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience.By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards.

 

HOW you will contribute to the company

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).

  • You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes.

  • You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them.

  • You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed.

  • You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt).

  • You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform.

 

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month:

  • You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.

  • You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.

  • You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.

Within 3 months:

  • You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers.

  • You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).

  • You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.

Within 6 months:

  • You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap.

  • You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform.

  • You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.

And beyond: the data team will continue growing with the company

Which means:

  • Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members

  • Increased accountability in project leadership

  • Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.

 

Who are we looking for?

You’re the right candidate if you:

  • Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)

  • Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools

  • Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team

  • You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders

  • Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

  • Are Fluent in French & English

 

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.
